source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typeset paper rendered as page images (no usable text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: Quarterly Examination 2017-2018, Std. VIII, Subject : Biology, Full Marks : 80, Time : 2hrs.+15 min.; examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed academic year (file name also says 2018). No school name printed. Section A [40 marks] answer all; Section B [40 marks] answer any four of five questions, so entries add to 90 against the paper total of 80. Where a mark is printed only for a group of items it is kept as one entry with that total; [2+4] and [2+1] are kept as single entries. Most items (cell, tissues, nutrition, branches of biology) have no matching Class 8 chapter in the taxonomy and are left unmapped. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
